ORDER DENYING DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS

LAW AND MOTION 302, EFENDANT SIMILARWEB, INC.'S MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS IS DENIED. SIMILARWEB MUST FILE AN ANSWER OR OTHER PERMISSIBLE RESPONSE TO THE COMPLAINT NO LATER THAN SEPTEMBER 1, 2026. SERVICE OF A SUMMONS AND COMPLAINT AFTER THE 60 DAY PERIOD IN CRC 3.110(B) DOES NOT INVALIDATE THE SERVICE NOR DOES IT RELIEVE THE SERVED PARTY OF RESPONDING TO THE COMPLAINT. CRC 3.110(F) SPECIFIES THE SOLE REMEDY FOR LATE SERVICE, WHICH ALLOWS THE COURT IN ITS DISCRETION TO ISSUE AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE WHY SANCTIONS SHALL NOT BE IMPOSED. SINCE SERVICE HAS BEEN EFFECTED, THE COURT EXERCISES ITS DISCRETION NOT TO ISSUE AN ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE. COUNSEL FOR THE PREVAILING PARTY IS REQUIRED TO PREPARE A PROPOSED ORDER WHICH REPEATS VERBATIM THE COURT'S RULING AND MUST DROP A HARD COURTESY COPY IN DEPT. 302'S INBOX.VISITING JUDGE: HAROLD E. KAHN; CLERK: M. MACADANGDANG; NOT REPORTED. (302/HEK)

MOTION TO QUASH SERVICE OF SUMMONS OR STAY OR DISMISS
Off Calendar Aug-17-2026 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:

No appearances. The Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

Defendant Similarweb, Inc.'s motion to quash service of summons is denied.

Similarweb must file an answer or other permissible response to the complaint no later than September 1, 2026. Service of a summons and complaint after the 60 day period in CRC 3.110(b) does not invalidate the service nor does it relieve the served party of responding to the complaint. CRC 3.110(f) specifies the sole remedy for late service, which allows the court in its discretion to issue an order to show cause why sanctions shall not be imposed. Since service has been effected, the court exercises its discretion not to issue an order to show cause.

Counsel for the prevailing party is required to prepare a proposed order which repeats verbatim the court's ruling and must drop a hard courtesy copy in Dept. 302's inbox.

Visiting Judge: Harold E. Kahn; Clerk: M. Macadangdang; Not Reported. (302/HEK)
